sources.entry: Comic Commander - Comic library browser and reader for CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT, and PDF files. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/krocon/comic-commander-tauri) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Comic Commander
summary.one_liner: A comic library browser and reader that shows your collection as a wall of cover images, with a built-in reader for CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT and PDF files.
use_cases: browse a digital comic collection by cover
read CBZ or CBR comic archives
organize comics by series or folder
track reading progress across comic volumes
filter a large comic library by writer, year or series
summary.what_it_does: The app displays every book in a collection as its cover, arranged edge to edge, and lets you scroll by series or by folder. A series is shown with the cover of its first volume, the number of volumes, and how far you have read. A type-as-you-filter search supports operators such as series, year ranges and writer, plus exclusions like -album. Results can be sorted by series and number, name, date or size. Cover size, filter and position are remembered per category, and keyboard shortcuts are listed for switching views and opening a book to read.
notable: Series view uses the first volume's cover and shows volume count and read progress
Search filters by series, year range, writer, and exclusions
Built-in reader for CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT and PDF
caveats: Pricing is described as free and open source; no paid tier is mentioned on the page
The awesome-mac listing marks it as Freeware, and the page does not describe any platform limits beyond macOS, Windows and Linux
